description: Nobody likes being bombarded by unsolicited text messages from spammers and scammers. I supported and voted for HB2498, a bill introduced by my colleague Republican Representative Gail Griffin. This bill, which bans unsolicited text messages in Arizona, passed with bipartisan support and was signed into law by Katie Hobbs.
